What you will need:

  • 3 fist sized red onions
  • 6 fist sized potatoes
  • 200 gramms of smoked ham (alternatively you can use anything smoked, like sausages, even meat)
  • 2 cloves of garlic
  • a pot
  • a pan
  • olive oil (alternatively you can use butter, but make sure its from actual milk, margarine is poison)

  • salt and pepper

  • Step 1: sharpen your kitchen knife. If you cant shave with it, sharpen it some more.

  • Step 2: peel the potatoes and cut them in relatively small pieces.
  • Step 3: boil potato pieces until its easy to smash in generously salted water. It will take 20-50 minutes, depending potatoe type. Clean your cutting board and your knife.
  • Step 4: cut up the onions to small pieces. The smaller, the tastier. If your tears are not flowing like a river, next time buy some real onions. Clean your cutting board and your knife.
  • Step 5: cut your smoked ham in cubes and cut your garlic very small. Dont mash garlic, you will lose the precious juice. Your cutting board doesnt need said juices.
  • Step 6: oil your pan. Dont be shy, its virgin oil. Its good for you anyway.
  • Step 7: roast the onions until you spot the first brown pieces. Dont be alarmed that your pan is likely nearly full with onions, it will reduce in volume greatly by the time the dish is ready. Stir regularly.
  • Step 8: after you noticed the first brown pieces of onions, put in the ham and garlic and keep stirring until the ham is nicely cooked, but not roasted.
  • Step 9: add the potatoes and start smashing it with the edge of your spatula and mix it up, but do not make a creme. You want to taste potato pieces in the end.
  • Step 10: keep stirring and mixing for a couple minutes(5-7) or until the potato is a bit roasted, but i like my potato cooked, not roasted. Its up to you.
  • Step 11: Enjoy. Add salt and pepper individually for each dish for your taste.
